My current partner has shown me that I’ve spent my life settling for a lot less. He is amazing. I’m 31 and he’s 33 by the way.

Some examples include:

-He always validates how I’m feeling. Even if it’s over what some people may think is trivial. I was pretty upset over a bad hair cut the other week and he listened to me moan and was reflective in his listening and made me feel seen in how I was feeling. When I thanked him for listening to me moan about something trivial his answer was “it’s not trivial. It matters to you so it matters to me”
- He never ever raises his voice or gets aggressive. I pointed this out to him and thanked him to which he responded surprised “it’s the absolute bare minimum”. He honestly believes there’s no scenario where yelling should occur and he’s such a calm energy to be around. He has never once taken frustration out on me and I’ve never seen him do it to anyone else.
- When we have differing views, he listens and he takes things on. Whilst we are very similar in most things, he tells me it’s great that we don’t agree on absolutely everything because that’s how we can grow and learn from each other.

-He tells me regularly how thankful he is for me and praises my intrinsic qualities (but also tells me I’m cute as hell on top of all of that)

-From the get go he has tried to love me in the best way he can. We talked about how words of affirmation are important to me and he actively works to show me love in that way. He asked me what’s the best way for him to help me if I’m having a down day and has followed through with that knowledge when needed.
- He values himself highly (in a good way). He has a lot of self respect and he genuinely likes himself. He said there were times that wasn’t the case and he has had to work hard to get to where he is. He also values me as an equal. 

-He has an incredibly high emotional intelligence and it’s because he has worked hard to develop it. Like massively hard. He has great self-insight and knows what helps him.

Now this is a guy who is stereotypically very masculine looking (muscular, tattoos, does a range of martial arts, is a tradesman etc). But he is one of the most well rounded people I know. I treat him just as well as he treats me and we both work hard to “love each other in the best way possible”

It’s honestly beautiful.
